The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Ebooks online

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a system that allows digital creators to build and run their online stores independent of conventional payment platforms. This is crucial in regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal operate under strict limitations, as they only serve 46 out of 195 countries globally. By leveraging tools such as Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments, creators can maintain full control over their sales and payment processes, ensuring they are not reliant on any third-party service that could potentially restrict access or hold funds.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, sovereign commerce infrastructure consists of free or low-cost components that work seamlessly together. For instance, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide hosting, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Order storage can be managed using Supabase or Google Sheets, and file delivery is facilitated through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, NOWPayments enables automatic crypto payment processing with minimal fees, ensuring that transactions are fast and secure without the need for KYC or buyer accounts. This architecture not only provides reliability but also ensures that creators retain full ownership of their data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in countries where traditional payment platforms are either unavailable or heavily restricted. This includes creators selling ebooks, courses, software, and other digital products who need a reliable way to accept payments. By utilizing sovereign commerce infrastructure, these creators can build their online businesses without the fear of sudden account suspensions or payment rejections. Instead, they can focus on creating quality content and engaging with their audience, knowing their payment processing needs are fully met.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers you to own your online store.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce stack consists of several key components that each play a critical role in the overall functionality. Hosting is taken care of by platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, providing a robust environment for your online store. Backend logic is managed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring smooth operations. For order management, Supabase or Google Sheets can be utilized, while file delivery is handled through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payment processing is executed via NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with low fees, making it an ideal choice for creators in restricted regions looking for a dependable solution.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with your sovereign commerce stack, first, select the components you will use for hosting, backend logic, and order management. For example, you could choose Cloudflare Pages for hosting and Supabase for order storage. Next, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Once your components are selected, deploy your stack by setting up each part according to the documentation provided. For a comprehensive solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes everything needed to deploy in just 48 hours. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore your options.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
No more account suspensions or payment holds; you control your finances.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Begin by choosing your hosting platform, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, select a backend service, such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, to handle logic. Set up order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. Integrate NOWPayments for payment processing and configure your product delivery method with Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, test your setup to ensure everything works seamlessly before launching your store.
Frequently Asked Questions

You can create an independent online store using sovereign commerce infrastructure. Use platforms like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and integrate NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrency. This allows you to sell digital products without depending on restricted payment platforms.
What is the best alternative to Gumroad for creators in restricted countries?

Sovereign commerce stacks provide an excellent alternative to Gumroad. By building your own store with tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you can sell digital products without the limitations imposed by traditional platforms.
Can I use PayPal if I am in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan?

PayPal does not operate in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan, which can severely limit your ability to receive payments. Instead, consider using sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows for crypto payments and full control over your sales.
What are the fees associated with NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction, making it an affordable option for digital creators. Additionally, there are no KYC requirements or buyer accounts needed, simplifying the payment process.
How can I ensure my payments are secure?

By utilizing NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, you ensure secure transactions as payments are verified on-chain. The infrastructure is designed to protect your financial information and provide a reliable payment experience.
